primitives.name: Typewriter
primitives.description: Characters appear one at a time in their final places, left to right, in hard steps; optionally a solid caret, the newest letters drawn lighter and darkening behind, or each new letter flashing before it settles.

params.name: caret
params.meaning: solid caret after the last character

params.name: trailLetters
params.meaning: newest letters drawn lighter than the settled ones

variants.name: jittered
variants.notes: uneven gaps of 2-5 f and one long pause

variants.name: letterFade
variants.notes: each letter fades in light and steps up to full about 10 f later

variants.name: fadeTrail
variants.notes: two measured instances of the same lighter-trail typing

variants.name: stretchFade
variants.notes: per-letter fade or horizontal stretch-in per line

variants.name: acceleratingDots
variants.notes: types inside a growing capsule, then a dot-by-dot ellipsis

variants.name: leadingEdge
variants.notes: letters cut on just inside the leading frame edge of a pan

variants.name: flashLetter
variants.notes: first letters slide in blurred, the rest type with a flash on the newest

primitives.name: WordPop
primitives.description: Words (or whole lines) of a pre-laid line appear one at a time, each in a single frame at full ink in its final place, with no fade, slide or scale; the cadence in frames per unit carries the rhythm.

variants.name: rapid
variants.notes: fast output streaming at 2-3 f per word

variants.name: lineSteps
variants.notes: whole lines at fixed slots, irregular gaps

variants.name: ghostSnap
variants.notes: each word shows dim just below its place, then snaps up to full

primitives.name: Scramble
primitives.description: A word resolves out of order through placeholder bars and dots, letter by letter, until every glyph has settled.

primitives.name: LetterPopBuild
primitives.description: A short row builds out of order: each letter enters by its own small move (grows from a speck, spins in, splits from a twin, drops and bounces, slides out from behind a neighbour) while the row tightens or re-centres.

variants.name: mixedPops
variants.notes: the letter moves and the out-of-order typing with re-centring are one build

variants.name: tighten
variants.notes: a glyph slides into its slot with overshoot, letters pop in at loose spacing that tightens

primitives.name: SoftFrontReveal
primitives.description: Text is revealed by a soft feathered front moving left to right: letters arrive light and darken behind the front; reversed, lines dissolve away letter-wise, left parts first.

params.name: slide
params.meaning: sideways slide of the line while it darkens

primitives.name: ShimmerSweep
primitives.description: A soft band of lighter or darker tone crosses text, a pill, a card or grid lines from left to right and leaves; once, on each rest, or on a loop.

variants.name: darkBand
variants.notes: a darker band, stepped like a screen capture

variants.name: lineLight
variants.notes: thin grid lines light up and fade as the sweep passes

primitives.name: RiseFade
primitives.description: Units (letters, words, lines or a block) fade in while rising or dropping a few pixels into place on one ease-out, on a fixed stagger; with no travel it is a plain fade in place.
primitives.api: {text?: string; children?: React.ReactNode; tone?: Tone; variant?: string}

params.name: rise
params.meaning: travel into place, negative = drop from above

variants.name: fadeInPlace
variants.notes: a plain ease-out fade in place, on a label and on a small mark

variants.name: quickFade
variants.notes: a 2-6 f fade of a thin separator

primitives.name: BlurIn
primitives.description: Units fade in from defocused to sharp in their places, optionally rising a few pixels; staggered by letter, word or line, or rolling so each word peaks in focus and defocuses out as the next one peaks.

primitives.name: BlurSlideIn
primitives.description: Lines, words, letters or glyphs slide in from the frame edges with directional motion blur and lock into place on a hard ease-out or a stiff spring, sometimes overshooting; pairs come from opposite sides.

variants.name: trackingSettle
variants.notes: the line lands stretched and its spacing tightens into place

variants.name: allEdges
variants.notes: letters arrive from all four edges, then the line rises into place

primitives.name: WarpFlyIn
primitives.description: Text flies in as a liquid, rubbery or chrome-like warped smear and resolves into its letterforms as it lands; a liquid blob can morph into the first letters.

variants.name: chromeSmear
variants.notes: lines arrive as horizontal smears from opposite edges, then the lockup scales up to rest

primitives.name: EdgeRise
primitives.description: Text springs in vertically from beyond the frame edge or from far below its slot, overshoots and settles like a damped spring; elements follow on a stagger.

variants.name: typeRise
variants.notes: types on while it rises

variants.name: popDrop
variants.notes: pops on at full ink and drops into its slot, ease-out, no overshoot

primitives.name: TextFadeOut
primitives.description: Text fades out in place on an ease-in, all together or line by line in reading order, optionally defocusing as it goes; no move or scale.

variants.name: defocusLines
variants.notes: lines leave one at a time, fading and defocusing

primitives.name: HardCut
primitives.description: The picture is replaced between two frames; the next layout is complete in the cut frame or builds from the empty canvas; an overlay can hold across the cut, or a move can continue through it in the same direction.
primitives.api: {from: React.ReactNode; to: React.ReactNode; tone?: Tone; variant?: string}; also <name>Presentation(variant?) and its timing for TransitionSeries

params.name: emptyFrames
params.meaning: empty canvas frames before the next layout builds

primitives.name: DipToBackground
primitives.description: The outgoing layout fades out in place on an ease-in (optionally scaling a few percent), the empty background holds for a few frames, and the next layout builds in.
primitives.api: {from: React.ReactNode; to: React.ReactNode; tone?: Tone; variant?: string}; also <name>Presentation(variant?) and its timing for TransitionSeries

params.name: emptyFrames
params.meaning: empty background frames between the layouts

variants.name: zoomBuild
variants.notes: composite: zoom or shrink fade-out, settle-in of the next layout, headline last

primitives.name: WhipCut
primitives.description: Whip through a hidden cut: the outgoing view eases in along one axis with growing directional blur, the picture is replaced at speed, and the incoming view (the next layout or a closer framing of the same one) arrives still moving and decelerates on a strong ease-out.
primitives.api: {from: React.ReactNode; to: React.ReactNode; tone?: Tone; variant?: string}; also <name>Presentation(variant?) and its timing for TransitionSeries

params.name: scaleJump
params.meaning: framing change at the cut, 1 for none

variants.name: blendLeft
variants.notes: a few blurred frames blend both shots

variants.name: layerBlur
variants.notes: the blur sits on the content layer only, the frame chrome stays sharp

variants.name: punchUp
variants.notes: the incoming view is a closer framing of the same layout

primitives.name: PushSlide
primitives.description: Vertical push: the outgoing layout accelerates up out of the top edge and the next one rises in from below the frame and brakes to rest; the two may sit on one strip, overlap, or swap at a hidden cut.
primitives.api: {from: React.ReactNode; to: React.ReactNode; tone?: Tone; variant?: string}; also <name>Presentation(variant?) and its timing for TransitionSeries

variants.name: dipRise
variants.notes: the incoming element dips to near transparent at its fastest

primitives.name: ZoomThrough
primitives.description: A zoom on one point accelerates toward the camera and carries through into the next scene, which continues the motion and settles; with radial streaks, a dissolve, a spin, or one dark vignetted picture.
primitives.api: {from: React.ReactNode; to: React.ReactNode; tone?: Tone; variant?: string}; also <name>Presentation(variant?) and its timing for TransitionSeries

params.name: toScale
params.meaning: scale reached on the outgoing side

variants.name: radialStreaks
variants.notes: the curve is the incoming shot recovering from its darkest picture

primitives.name: CollapseToPoint
primitives.description: A group folds into one point or one cell: a plane wraps into a globe and shrinks to a dot, cells shrink into the centre one by one, rings fold inward step by step, a glowing blob implodes, merged shapes shrink to nothing.

params.name: stepGap
params.meaning: frames between successive cells or rings

primitives.name: FlyToSlots
primitives.description: A set of elements travels on straight or arced paths into target slots on one shared ease-in-out, optionally scaling to the slot size; staggered starts, so speed scales with distance.

variants.name: swoopAcross
variants.notes: one element swoops through the centre to the mirror position, growing

primitives.name: ShapeSwap
primitives.description: Each element swaps in place for another: the old one shrinks and fades while the new one grows and fades in, all at once or as a wave across the set.

params.name: fromScale
params.meaning: start scale of the incoming shape

primitives.name: ContentSwap
primitives.description: Part of a held layout is replaced while the rest stays: a title fades and the next pops into its slot, a panel slides through, a grid drops out and the next drops in, a screen crossfades while its content slides up, or a label or glyph swaps in one frame.
primitives.api: {from: React.ReactNode; to: React.ReactNode; tone?: Tone; variant?: string}; also <name>Presentation(variant?) and its timing for TransitionSeries

variants.name: slideThrough
variants.notes: the slide-through of one window and the composite it belongs to

variants.name: dropThrough
variants.notes: the old grid drops out, the new one drops in

variants.name: oneFrame
variants.notes: text or a glyph is replaced in a single frame

primitives.name: LightFlash
primitives.description: Light covers the frame and the picture is replaced under it: a white disc grows from a point, a ring blooms into white and the next shot comes down from it, a flare band peaks on the cut, two stars split apart over the next shot, or a ring inverts what it passes.
primitives.api: {from: React.ReactNode; to: React.ReactNode; tone?: Tone; variant?: string}; also <name>Presentation(variant?) and its timing for TransitionSeries

variants.name: ringBloom
variants.notes: the bloom into white and the come-down of the next shot

primitives.name: StarFlare
primitives.description: A four-point sparkle star and its light streaks: a star drops in growing, a streak led by a sparkle sweeps along a title and parks at its end, a full-width anamorphic streak through a point light, or stars fixed in depth that ride the camera.

primitives.name: LumaPulse
primitives.description: A brief luminance pulse on one element: a halo or bloom builds and drains, a layer flashes for two pictures, an element dips to near transparent at its fastest, or a screen flickers through its content swap.

variants.name: bloomCover
variants.notes: the bloom hides a content swap at its peak

variants.name: fillGlow
variants.notes: a pressed fill brightens and a glow spills, no shrink

primitives.name: RadialBurst
primitives.description: Elements burst out radially from a point and expand past the frame edges while fading: glowing square tiles, concentric outline copies, soft shockwave rings, angular shards, a ring band of halftone dots.

primitives.name: PixelBlocks
primitives.description: Luminous pixel squares as an ornament: a band of them sweeps across an element and dims out, a soft pixel smear trails behind text, or two squares slide into a corner-to-corner pair.

primitives.name: ToneShift
primitives.description: An element's ink or fill changes tone in place: text lightens, or dims and returns, older lines fall back while a new one darkens, a tone sweep runs across a line, a fill darkens to its rest tone.

primitives.name: SlowZoom
primitives.description: Slow zoom or drift during holds so the frame is never still: an eased push-in that settles before the next cut, a near-linear creep, or a constant linear scale or position drift of the whole layout.
primitives.api: {children: React.ReactNode; variant?: string} (moves the whole layer it wraps)

variants.name: layerPush
variants.notes: a layer move about a fixed point, not the whole frame

variants.name: linearDrift
variants.notes: constant linear drift between moves, two measured instances

variants.name: groupCreep
variants.notes: the held group scales up linearly over a still background

variants.name: recede
variants.notes: slow linear shrink until the cut

primitives.name: PushIn
primitives.description: The camera pushes in on a region and settles: slow start, a fast blurred middle and an ease-out into a creep, about the frame centre or a point off it; or a scale jump in one picture after an accelerating approach.
primitives.api: {children: React.ReactNode; variant?: string} (moves the whole layer it wraps)

variants.name: layerPunch
variants.notes: one layer punches in while the text beside it keeps its size

primitives.name: PullBack
primitives.description: The camera pulls back to reveal more of the layout on an eased slow-fast-slow move (often eased in log scale), with blur on its fastest pictures, about the frame centre or a point near an edge, sometimes with a pan.
primitives.api: {children: React.ReactNode; variant?: string} (moves the whole layer it wraps)

variants.name: panLead
variants.notes: with a pan that leads the zoom; the composite transition it drives

variants.name: centred
variants.notes: the same pull-back without the pan, under a composite transition

primitives.name: CanvasPan
primitives.description: The camera pans or tilts across one canvas on an eased curve with directional blur at peak speed, sometimes with a small zoom; whip-like pans start slowly, burst for a few pictures and settle long.
primitives.api: {children: React.ReactNode; variant?: string} (moves the whole layer it wraps)

variants.name: whipReframe
variants.notes: the jump picture also re-frames the layout

primitives.name: AccelerateExit
primitives.description: The whole layout (or one block) accelerates out along one axis or in scale on an ease-in with growing motion blur and is cut at speed, with no settle; optionally after an anticipation dip.
primitives.api: {children: React.ReactNode; variant?: string} (moves the whole layer it wraps)

variants.name: anticipateUp
variants.notes: dips before it accelerates up

variants.name: peekSnap
variants.notes: holds cut off by the edge, then leaves in two pictures

primitives.name: CutInSettle
primitives.description: After a hard cut the new view arrives offset, zoomed or blurred and still moving, and settles on a strong ease-out.
primitives.api: {children: React.ReactNode; variant?: string} (moves the whole layer it wraps)

variants.name: punchIn
variants.notes: the cut is to a closer framing of the same layout

variants.name: ghostCarry
variants.notes: an element of the previous layout rides the settle as a pale band

primitives.name: SteppedZoom
primitives.description: A zoom made of quick discrete steps between near-holds, or of stepped, differently centred crops each held to the next picture; the measured curve is the envelope the steps follow.
primitives.api: {children: React.ReactNode; variant?: string} (moves the whole layer it wraps)

primitives.name: PerspectiveSwing
primitives.description: A flat line or card turns in perspective: it morphs into a keystone taper right after landing, swings flat from a tilt while growing, or a mirrored pair turns its top edges apart and back.

variants.name: swingIn
variants.notes: the line swings flat from its tilt while it types on

primitives.name: CardSpin3D
primitives.description: A card turns in 3D: a half turn about its vertical axis braking to a frontal rest, a yaw then recede, a push back to rest size, or a light-up while a sheen crosses it.

primitives.name: LayerStack
primitives.description: A stack of parallel layers in 3D: it separates along a diagonal, fans out, collapses back, one layer sinks on its own, the rear cards fold into the front one, or new cards land on its front on a fixed interval.

primitives.name: Camera3D
primitives.description: The camera moves through a 3D scene: orbits, dollies with parallax, swings into perspective and pushes in, pushes until a layer flattens to the screen, shrinks a flat page into a stack, or flies down a one-point tunnel.

primitives.name: GlobeRise
primitives.description: The dome of a globe tiled with footage rises from the bottom edge on a strong ease-out, then spins about its vertical axis at a constant rate.

primitives.name: DepthFlyer
primitives.description: Small folded 3D shapes fly into depth toward a vanishing point, shrinking and decelerating, each pulling a particle trail; or one dives out through the bottom edge.

primitives.name: OrbitRig
primitives.description: A rig of rings orbits a centre as one rigid unit: halftone-dot circles spin about a tilted axis, passing in front of and behind the content, or a faint wireframe of orbit ellipses tumbles behind it.

primitives.name: PressBounce
primitives.description: A pressed button, chip or row squashes about its centre, holds, and springs back (or stays pressed); state changes land on the deepest picture.

params.name: pressScale
params.meaning: scale at the bottom of the press

primitives.name: SeedGrow
primitives.description: A box or pill is born as a seed (a dot, a dash, a thin line or a blurred speck) and grows to its size along one axis and then the other, on an explosive ease-out or with an overshoot; it can stretch with a typed label and collapse back to a line.

params.name: overshoot
params.meaning: size past rest at the peak

variants.name: cornerFollow
variants.notes: small squares fly out to the box corners and follow its resize

variants.name: chainIn
variants.notes: anchor dot, leader line, then the pill grows from a speck

primitives.name: Dropdown
primitives.description: A menu opens from its anchor: it unfolds or scales up with motion blur while the camera re-frames to it, and closes by squashing back into its anchor.

params.name: fromScale
params.meaning: menu scale when it starts to open

primitives.name: Counter
primitives.description: A number changes in place: it counts with an accelerating rate, ticks as a real-time timer, steps on events, swaps readings once per picture, or a dial knob fast-forwards around its ring while its digits count.
primitives.api: {from: number; to: number; tone?: Tone; variant?: string}

primitives.name: ItemRiseIn
primitives.description: List or feed items appear one at a time below the earlier ones: each fades in while rising a few pixels on an ease-out, or pops in at full value one per picture, in reading order.

primitives.name: StepScroll
primitives.description: A list moves up by one item's height as a new item arrives: in a single frame, or as an eased step over a slow base drift.

primitives.name: PageScroll
primitives.description: Page content scrolls inside a still frame on a smooth ease-in-out, on a momentum curve with a long deceleration, or arrives mid-scroll and decelerates to rest.

variants.name: slowBack
variants.notes: scrolls back to the first line, slowing

primitives.name: Marquee
primitives.description: A row scrolls sideways at a constant speed: it arrives fast and brakes into its cruise, ramps its speed between holds, or stops dead after a number of slots.

primitives.name: BusyIndicator
primitives.description: A working indicator loops while something is pending: a glyph or dot spinner steps through its frames, an arc spins at a constant rate, an icon pulses its tone, a placeholder flashes on and off, or a mark makes one full turn and stops.

primitives.name: FloatingPill
primitives.description: A floating status pill or toast with its icon: it enters (drops along a curve, rises through the bottom edge with an overshoot, whips up), drifts against the layer under it, and leaves (smears out, fades and slides, lifts and drops away).

primitives.name: SlideSettle
primitives.description: An element shifts a short distance into place while it fades in or sharpens, on a long ease-out; more follow on a stagger.

primitives.name: EdgeEnter
primitives.description: An element enters from beyond a frame edge with directional motion blur and lands on a hard ease-out, sometimes with a small overshoot.

variants.name: trailSlide
variants.notes: a long arrow with ghost trails

primitives.name: ScaleFade
primitives.description: A group fades in while growing slightly about its centre (and rising) on an ease-out, or fades out while shrinking or zooming slightly on an ease-in.

params.name: fromScale
params.meaning: scale at the start of an entrance

params.name: toScale
params.meaning: scale at the end of an exit

primitives.name: OversizeSettle
primitives.description: An element enters oversized (often blurred and cut by the frame edge) and shrinks to rest about its anchor on a fast-start ease-out.

primitives.name: MakeRoom
primitives.description: A settled block moves, shrinks or re-centres to make room for what arrives next: it rises to the top band, slides and shrinks aside, re-centres as content is inserted, or opens a gap inside a line.

primitives.name: SplitApart
primitives.description: Parts of a block move apart: lines slide to opposite sides, a line splits up and down, split lines whip out in their directions, grid spacing opens, settled lines kick apart and lock again, or one element becomes a mirrored pair.

primitives.name: LockupSlide
primitives.description: A mark slides aside on a symmetric ease-in-out (optionally shrinking) to make room for the wordmark, which appears in its place as the slide ends.

primitives.name: CaptionDrift
primitives.description: Caption lines stand offset like stairs and the whole block slides at a constant velocity for its whole life, away from the direction its lines step.

variants.name: stairDrift
variants.notes: the stair layout and its drift are one caption device

primitives.name: ScalePop
primitives.description: An element scales up from small about its own centre while it fades in, on a strong ease-out or on a spring that overshoots and settles; a tilt or spin can straighten with it.

primitives.name: SpawnField
primitives.description: Many elements appear by a spawn pattern, each with the same small pop: one by one in reading order, as opposite pairs around a ring, on a radial front, at random spots, at the edges of a growing lattice, or in radial bursts.

primitives.name: AmbientLoop
primitives.description: Continuous cyclic motion on held elements: a sine float with its own phase per element, a scale pulse that takes turns, a squash pulse, level bars following the audio, or elements riding an ellipse at a constant angular speed.

primitives.name: IconFlyIn
primitives.description: An icon enters along a path and lands: it darts in from beyond an edge, drops into a card with a damped bounce, decelerates along an arc, or a chain follows its leader along an arc and dives into the target.

primitives.name: MarkBars
primitives.description: The two bars inside a mark move as one: they squash shut and reopen, slide together to a new position with a squash mid-move, open from closed dashes after a hold, slide, hold and slide back, or swap glyphs in one frame.

primitives.name: PacketHop
primitives.description: Small dots travel between nodes along connectors: hop centre to centre on an ease-in-out whose length hardly depends on distance, relay node to node, dispatch once to a receiver, or ping-pong linearly on a shared period.

primitives.name: LineDraw
primitives.description: A line or stroke draws on along its path: connectors grow edge to edge, a bracket draws out with rounded turns, edge ticks grow in, wireframe edges draw from back to front, an outline closes around a pill, a path draws on while its stroke thickens, or outline copies are revealed one after another.

variants.name: echoReveal
variants.notes: outline copies revealed down from the top edge, then widened with the layer they echo

primitives.name: Backdrop
primitives.description: The background field and its ambient changes: soft blobs breathe, fade in or clear, a dot grid drifts, halftone glows swell and travel, ribbons rise or drift, a diagonal split rides the camera, a dotted beam bridges two elements, or a feathered zone clears the field behind text.

primitives.name: CursorPath
primitives.description: A pointer travels on its own: it flies in from beyond an edge and decelerates onto a target, glides between targets (thrown fast and eased out, or in-out), winds up and swoops, or accelerates off the frame.

primitives.name: CursorState
primitives.description: The pointer changes form or marks a click: it glows up and swaps for a 3D pointer that turns frontal, sharpens and dims to rest, swaps in one picture hidden in a fast move, or leaves a small expanding ring.

primitives.name: DragDrop
primitives.description: Items are dragged and dropped: a file is carried along a path and shrinks into its target, outline copies travel as one grid, a selected block is dragged out accelerating, a dropped strip docks and splits into clips, or clips butt together and gaps open.

primitives.name: SelectionHighlight
primitives.description: A selection or hover state moves onto an element: a highlight pill fades in and widens, a card lifts with an outline and shadow, tiles light row by row, a slot holds while rows pass through it, the selection jumps to a new chip, or a selector frame hops between items.

primitives.name: FootageCard
primitives.description: A card carrying footage moves as one unit: it zooms from a small card to fill the frame, flies in on a diagonal and snaps into place, shrinks to become a node, grows from a speck in depth, or zooms in from scattered specks into a row.
primitives.api: {footage?: string; tone?: Tone; variant?: string} (a FootageSlot inside)

primitives.name: FootageFrame
primitives.description: Footage carried by a fixed window or mask: the footage cuts inside it while the layout holds (single cuts or a quick burst), a curved-screen mask whose edges can wobble as it whips out, footage fading in from the card fill, or a scrim that dims the footage under text.
primitives.api: {footage?: string; tone?: Tone; variant?: string} (a FootageSlot inside)

variants.name: wobbleExit
variants.notes: the mask edges go soft and bulge while the panel whips out

variants.name: heldDim
variants.notes: static scrim under a held headline

primitives.name: MaskReveal
primitives.description: Footage (or an edited version of it) is revealed inside a card by a moving mask: a glowing dot-matrix ring expands from a point, a light scan band sweeps across, a seam sweeps open with the content riding its edge, or a strip opens from a thin line.
primitives.api: {footage?: string; tone?: Tone; variant?: string} (a FootageSlot inside)

primitives.name: FootageSlot
primitives.description: The footage carrier: fills the card, window or mask around it with the user footage, or with a gray plate when none is given. Motion belongs to the frame that holds it.

params.name: fit
params.meaning: how the footage fills the slot
